description: Audited agricultural county ETL with provenance, explicit join coverage and atomic constrained SQLite warehouse

issues.title: Confirm original soil and excluded weather units
issues.body: SM_WHC and SM_DEPTH retain unverified source units. VPRES/WSPD/RAD are audited but excluded from the warehouse. Obtain primary field metadata before conversions or quantitative recommendations.

issues.title: Investigate archived zero yields and selective coverage
issues.body: The source contains 501 zero yields and large unmatched soil/weather coverage. Confirm semantics and missingness causes with the source documentation without treating every unmatched row as invalid.
